description: This Java class provides utility methods to read, write, and process ConfigurationImage objects to and from files, handling headers and byte arrays.

classes.name: ConfigurationImageFile
classes.description: Utility class for reading and writing ConfigurationImage instances to files, handling headers, streams, and byte arrays.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads a ConfigurationImage object from the specified file.

methods.name: readFromStream
methods.description: Reads a ConfigurationImage from an input stream, verifying header and returning null if invalid.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Converts a ConfigurationImage object into a byte array suitable for file storage, including the header.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves a ConfigurationImage object to the specified file.
